name: dotnet LawnDart eShop Catalog
description: Catalog bounded context for a LawnDart-style rewrite of Microsoft eShop Catalog.API. Backoffice populate first, then shopper browse/search, then stock reactions to Ordering. Brand/Type/Restock write gaps called out as questions.

widgets.name: Catalog Admin
widgets.description: Backoffice operator who defines brands, types, and catalog items.

widgets.name: Shopper
widgets.description: Customer who browses and searches the catalog (same business role as Identity Shopper).

widgets.name: Catalog Brand
widgets.description: Brand classification for catalog items (eShop CatalogBrand; seed + GET only today). Stream key: catalog-brand:{brandId}.

widgets.name: Catalog Type
widgets.description: Type/category classification for catalog items (eShop CatalogType; seed + GET only today). Stream key: catalog-type:{typeId}.

widgets.name: Catalog Item
widgets.description: Sellable product in the catalog. Stream key: catalog-item:{itemId}. Stock fields live on the item (eShop CatalogItem).

state.name: OnReorder
state.description: Whether a restock is in progress

widgets.name: Define Catalog Brand
widgets.description: Defines a new brand used to classify catalog items.

widgets.name: Catalog Brand Defined
widgets.description: A catalog brand was defined.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: When Define Catalog Brand then Catalog Brand Defined.

widgets.name: Define Catalog Type
widgets.description: Defines a new catalog type/category.

widgets.name: Catalog Type Defined
widgets.description: A catalog type was defined.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: When Define Catalog Type then Catalog Type Defined.

widgets.name: Add Catalog Item
widgets.description: Creates a new catalog item with price, brand, type, and initial stock.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Added
widgets.description: A catalog item was added. Tagged: catalog-item:{itemId}

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given brand and type defined, when Add Catalog Item then Catalog Item Added.

widgets.name: Catalog Item (Admin)
widgets.description: Admin projection of catalog item including stock thresholds.

state.name: Removed
state.description: True after the item is removed (final soft delete). The admin route still returns the item.

widgets.name: Update Catalog Item
widgets.description: Replaces catalog item details; emits Price Changed when price differs.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Updated
widgets.description: Catalog item details were updated.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Price Changed
widgets.description: Catalog item unit price changed (integration signal for other contexts). Basket does not consume it: basket lines keep add-time price snapshots.

widgets.name: Update without price change
widgets.description: Given item added, when Update Catalog Item with same price then Catalog Item Updated.

widgets.name: Price changed
widgets.description: Given item added, when Update Catalog Item with a new price then Catalog Item Updated and Catalog Item Price Changed.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Not Found
widgets.description: Fires when the catalog item does not exist: the id was never added, or the item was removed (removal is final). Checked after the item id, name, brand, type and price are valid. Message: "Catalog item does not exist."

widgets.name: Removed item
widgets.description: Given Catalog Item Added and Catalog Item Removed, when Update Catalog Item then Catalog Item Not Found.

widgets.name: Remove Catalog Item
widgets.description: Removes a catalog item from sale. Final soft delete: the item must exist and not already be removed.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Removed
widgets.description: Catalog item was removed. Final soft delete: the item is marked removed (Exists false, Removed true) and cannot be added again.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given item added, when Remove Catalog Item then Catalog Item Removed. Removal is final (soft delete).

widgets.name: Catalog Item Not Found
widgets.description: Fires when the catalog item does not exist: the id was never added, or the item was removed (removal is final). Message: "Catalog item does not exist."

widgets.name: Removed item
widgets.description: Given Catalog Item Added and Catalog Item Removed, when Remove Catalog Item then Catalog Item Not Found.

widgets.name: Restock Catalog Item
widgets.description: Adds units to available stock up to MaxStockThreshold.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Restocked
widgets.description: Stock was added to a catalog item.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given item added, when Restock Catalog Item then Catalog Item Restocked.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Not Found
widgets.description: Fires when the catalog item does not exist: the id was never added, or the item was removed (removal is final). Checked before the quantity. Message: "Catalog item does not exist."

widgets.name: Removed item
widgets.description: Given Catalog Item Added and Catalog Item Removed, when Restock Catalog Item then Catalog Item Not Found.

widgets.name: Catalog Browser
widgets.description: Paginated item list plus facet counts for brands and types.

state.name: Items
state.description: Page of catalog item summaries (item id, name, price, picture URL, available stock). Picture URL is /product-images/{itemId} when PictureFileName is set; empty picture uses the example image.

state.name: BrandFacets
state.description: Brand id + count pairs (brand names come from the Catalog Brands And Types view)

state.name: TypeFacets
state.description: Type id + count pairs (type names come from the Catalog Brands And Types view)

widgets.name: Catalog
widgets.description: Shopper catalog browsing screen. Each item thumbnail uses /product-images/{itemId} when the summary carries a picture file name; empty picture uses the example image. WebApp GET /product-images/{id} forwards to Catalog GET /api/catalog/items/{id}/pic. Browse, search, the item page and the cart use /product-images/{id} when the stored picture is a file name; an empty picture shows the example image.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Detail
widgets.description: Shopper-facing item detail read model. PictureUrl is /product-images/{itemId} when PictureFileName is set; otherwise the example image.

state.name: PictureUrl
state.description: Picture URL for the storefront. When PictureFileName is a plain file name this is /product-images/{itemId}, which WebApp forwards to Catalog GET /api/catalog/items/{id}/pic. An empty PictureFileName uses the example image.

state.name: IsAvailable
state.description: Whether item is listed and in stock

widgets.name: Item Detail
widgets.description: Shopper item detail page. The picture img src is /product-images/{itemId} when the item has a PictureFileName; empty picture uses the example image. WebApp GET /product-images/{id} forwards to Catalog GET /api/catalog/items/{id}/pic. Browse, search, the item page and the cart use /product-images/{id} when the stored picture is a file name; an empty picture shows the example image.

widgets.name: Catalog Search Results
widgets.description: Catalog items whose names start with the search text.

state.name: Query
state.description: Search text (matched as a name prefix)

state.name: Items
state.description: Item summaries whose names start with the search text (item id, name, description, price, picture URL, available stock, and IsAvailable: listed and in stock). Picture URL is /product-images/{itemId} when PictureFileName is set; empty picture uses the example image.

widgets.name: Catalog Search
widgets.description: Shopper search results display. Each result thumbnail uses /product-images/{itemId} when the summary carries a picture file name; empty picture uses the example image. WebApp GET /product-images/{id} forwards to Catalog GET /api/catalog/items/{id}/pic. Browse, search, the item page and the cart use /product-images/{id} when the stored picture is a file name; an empty picture shows the example image.

widgets.name: Route Awaiting Validation To Catalog
widgets.description: Subscribes to Ordering awaiting-validation signal; issues Validate Order Stock.

stepItems.name: Issue Validate Order Stock
stepItems.description: Pass order id and stock lines

widgets.name: On Order Awaiting Validation
widgets.description: Process trigger: Ordering marked order awaiting validation (wired via automation slice 1100 / integration event).

widgets.name: Validate Order Stock
widgets.description: Checks AvailableStock for each order line; confirms or rejects the order stock check.

widgets.name: Order Stock Confirmed
widgets.description: All requested units are available for the order.

widgets.name: Order Stock Rejected
widgets.description: One or more lines lack sufficient stock.

widgets.name: Stock available
widgets.description: Given item in stock, when Validate Order Stock then Order Stock Confirmed.

widgets.name: Insufficient stock
widgets.description: Given item with insufficient stock, when Validate Order Stock then Order Stock Rejected.

widgets.name: Order Stock Command Id Required
widgets.description: Fires when the command id is empty. Message: "Command identifier is required."

widgets.name: Order Stock Order Id Required
widgets.description: Fires when the order id is empty. Message: "Order id is required."

widgets.name: Order Stock Items Required
widgets.description: Fires when the order stock line list is missing or empty, or contains an empty line. Message: "Order stock items are required."

widgets.name: Order Stock Product Id Required
widgets.description: Fires when a line has an empty product id. Message: "Product id is required."

widgets.name: Order Stock Units Invalid
widgets.description: Fires when a line asks for zero or fewer units. Message: "Item units requested should be greater than zero."

widgets.name: Route Order Paid To Catalog
widgets.description: Subscribes to Ordering paid signal; issues Deduct Catalog Stock.

stepItems.name: Issue Deduct Catalog Stock
stepItems.description: Pass order id and stock lines

widgets.name: On Order Paid
widgets.description: Process trigger: order paid signal (wired via automation 1200).

widgets.name: Deduct Catalog Stock
widgets.description: Deducts stock for each paid order line. Each line removes the smaller of the requested units and the available stock, so stock never goes below 0. Units must be greater than zero. Available stock already at 0 is rejected.

widgets.name: Catalog Stock Deducted
widgets.description: Stock units were removed after a paid order. A line can remove fewer units than requested when stock runs short (take what's left).

state.name: Deductions
state.description: Item id + units actually removed (ItemId, UnitsRemoved). UnitsRemoved can be less than requested. The requested units are not recorded; the original RemoveStock only returns the removed count.

widgets.name: Catalog Item Out Of Stock
widgets.description: Available stock is already 0 (the original RemoveStock throws "Empty stock, product item ... is sold out"). Used only for zero stock: short stock deducts what's left instead.

widgets.name: Happy path
widgets.description: Given item with enough stock, when Deduct Catalog Stock then Catalog Stock Deducted with UnitsRemoved equal to the requested units.

widgets.name: Sold out
widgets.description: Given empty stock, when Deduct Catalog Stock then Catalog Item Out Of Stock.

widgets.name: Short stock
widgets.description: Given item with less stock than requested (e.g. 2 available, 5 requested), when Deduct Catalog Stock then Catalog Stock Deducted with UnitsRemoved = 2 and available stock 0.

widgets.name: Order Awaiting Validation (from Ordering)
widgets.description: Local mirror of Ordering evt-order-awaiting-validation for automation subscription resolution. Producer lives in Ordering workspace.

widgets.name: Order Paid (from Ordering)
widgets.description: Local mirror of Ordering evt-order-paid for automation subscription resolution. Producer lives in Ordering workspace.

widgets.name: Hold Integration Mirrors
widgets.description: Process trigger for the import-mirror holder slice. These events exist so automation subscribedEventIds resolve locally; they are not business emissions of Catalog/Basket/Payment/Ordering command slices.

widgets.name: Catalog Brands And Types
widgets.description: Lists every catalog brand and type with its display name, for the storefront filter lists and for API clients that add or update catalog items.

widgets.name: Catalog Filter Lists
widgets.description: Brand and type filter lists on the Catalog page (names, not ids).

widgets.name: Catalog Item Already Exists
widgets.description: An item with this item id was already added. Add Catalog Item rejects the duplicate; re-running the seed must check first.

widgets.name: Duplicate item id
widgets.description: Given Catalog Item Added for this item id, when Add Catalog Item with the same item id, then reject with Catalog Item Already Exists.

swimlanes.name: Define Catalog Brand
swimlanes.description: Backoffice creates a catalog brand. CRUD gap: eShop only seeds brands and exposes GET /api/catalog/catalogbrands.

swimlanes.name: Define Catalog Type
swimlanes.description: Backoffice creates a catalog type/category. CRUD gap: eShop only seeds types and exposes GET /api/catalog/catalogtypes.

swimlanes.name: Add Catalog Item
swimlanes.description: Backoffice adds a sellable catalog item. Maps to POST /api/catalog/items.

swimlanes.name: Catalog Item Detail (admin)
swimlanes.description: Admin read model for a single catalog item after add/update/restock/deduct, and after removal (Removed set; final soft delete).

swimlanes.name: Update Catalog Item
swimlanes.description: Backoffice updates item fields. When price changes, also emits Catalog Item Price Changed (eShop ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent).

swimlanes.name: Remove Catalog Item
swimlanes.description: Catalog admin removes a catalog item from sale (API only). Removal is a final soft delete. Catalog Item Removed sets Exists to false and Removed to true; the item stream stays. Add Catalog Item rejects a removed item id with CATALOG_ITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS, and Update, Remove and Restock reject it with CATALOG_ITEM_NOT_FOUND. Shopper views drop the item; the admin view keeps it with Removed set. eShop's DELETE is a hard delete.

swimlanes.name: Restock Catalog Item
swimlanes.description: Increments available stock (domain AddStock). CRUD/domain gap: no dedicated public restock API in eShop Catalog.API.

swimlanes.name: Browse Catalog
swimlanes.description: Shopper catalog list with brand/type facets and filters (WebApp Catalog page / GET items + facets).

swimlanes.name: View Catalog Item
swimlanes.description: Shopper item detail including picture. Catalog serves the item picture at GET /api/catalog/items/{id}/pic, where {id} is the catalog item id (mirrors eShop GetItemPictureById). It reads the item's PictureFileName and returns the image file (content types image/webp, image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/bmp, image/tiff, image/wmf, image/jp2, image/svg+xml). It returns 404 when the item is unknown or removed, the file is missing, or PictureFileName is not a single plain file name. The storefront page at /item/{itemId} loads the image through WebApp GET /product-images/{id}, which forwards to Catalog GET /api/catalog/items/{id}/pic. Browse, search, the item page and the cart use /product-images/{id} when the stored picture is a file name; an empty picture shows the example image.

swimlanes.name: Search Catalog
swimlanes.description: Plain name-prefix search: matches catalog items whose names start with the query text (upstream Catalog.API name filter).

swimlanes.name: Inbound Ordering Signals (mirrors)
swimlanes.description: Import-only holder for Ordering event mirrors so Catalog automations can resolve subscribedEventIds in-document. These are NOT emitted by Validate/Deduct command slices. Do not treat the Events zone here as Catalog domain emissions. Modeling scaffolding only, no code; real delivery is the producing context's integration event over the bus.

swimlanes.name: When Order Awaiting Validation Validate Stock
swimlanes.description: Automation: Ordering Order Awaiting Validation → issues Validate Order Stock. Forward-ref event id owned by Ordering workspace later.

swimlanes.name: Validate Order Stock
swimlanes.description: Catalog checks availability for order lines. One command with branching outcomes (Confirmed vs Rejected), preferred over two separate commands. Maps to AwaitingValidation handler.

swimlanes.name: When Order Paid Deduct Stock
swimlanes.description: Automation: Ordering Order Paid → issues Deduct Catalog Stock. Forward-ref event id owned by Ordering later.

swimlanes.name: Deduct Catalog Stock
swimlanes.description: Removes units from AvailableStock after payment (eShop OrderStatusChangedToPaid handler RemoveStock). Takes what's left: each line removes the smaller of the requested units and the available stock, and Catalog Stock Deducted records the units actually removed. Rejects only when available stock is already 0 (CATALOG_ITEM_OUT_OF_STOCK) or the quantity is zero or less, as the original RemoveStock does. A product id that is not in the catalog is skipped, as the original Paid handler does (catalogItem?.RemoveStock). This matches the original eShop: take what's left.

swimlanes.name: Catalog Brands And Types
swimlanes.description: Read model of brand and type names. Browse Catalog facets carry only ids and counts, so filter lists read names from here (upstream GET /api/catalog/catalogbrands and /catalogtypes).
